scope: Charge observed pending/orphan POLYLINE owner-map bucket-count growth into the existing bounded staging ledger and verify cleanup/reuse accounting with generated controls.

method.kind: Focused implementation slice with generated in-memory budget, rollback, cleanup, and reuse coverage

implementation.bucketCharge: For each owner map, max(bucket_count - initial_bucket_count, 0) * sizeof(void*); baseline default buckets are excluded.
implementation.budgetBehavior: Preflight a conservative possible bucket-growth bound against the remaining 256 MiB ledger, reserve, then verify actual bucket-count delta and retain/rollback conservatively if the implementation's growth exceeds the admitted charge.
implementation.ledgerValidation: Reconstruct pending-parent and orphan-owner map bucket deltas and include them in empty and non-empty staged-state validation.
implementation.cleanupAndReuse: Logical terminalization/abandonment does not release retained unordered-map capacity charge; same-reader reuse preserves the capacity charge while clearing logical states.
uncovered: allocator metadata, node padding beyond separate conservative node estimates, and allocator-retained memory
transient old-plus-new bucket-array peak during rehash
source-location-backed child leases, callbacks, and full DWG-reader pipeline coverage
